{
  "definition": {
    "id": "repeat_customer_count",
    "name": "期间内复购客户数",
    "grain": "customer within explicitly given period",
    "expression": "COUNT of customers with COUNT(invoice_id) >= 2 in period",
    "empty_behavior": "0 when no qualifying customers",
    "limitation": "Invoice records are not evidence of successful payment; crossing period bounds is not inferred"
  },
  "general_rules": {
    "date_field": "invoice.invoice_date",
    "period": "Half-open [start_date, end_date); no missing period is silently filled",
    "region": "customer.country is customer residence; invoice.billing_country is invoice billing address; equality in current snapshot does not merge meanings",

    "zero_denominator": "Return null and explain unavailable denominator"
  },
  "readonly_sql_example": {
    "id": "repeat_customers",
    "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS repeat_customers;",

      "text": "General Stratigraphy\nThe Shale Grit forms a wide spread on the moors in the\nsouthern part of the Sheet, where it is 450 to 550 feet thick.       "page": null,
      "section_path": [
        "四项指标的定义与限制",
        "热门曲目"
      ],
      "text": "热门曲目\n曲目最受欢迎沿用总计划的购买数量默认，即 SUM(invoice_line.quantity)。按销售额或按歌单收录数属于明确的备选口径，不能凭当前排名相同而互换。\n附录中的客户谁买得最多保留金额口径；没有查询对象的短语不套同一个全局默认。并列时以 track_id 升序稳定排序。D2登记口径，不提前实现 D3 完整澄清分级或口径切换。",
      "bbox": null,
      "source_file": {
        "path": "data/docs/raw/d2/Chinook业务指标口径手册.docx",
        "sha256": "b50f5683e735baa3ca6fe08bde3b437377d810732357e2a4898d6820b0456a9a",
        "exists": true
      },
      "source_url": "project-authored; notes/d2/业务指标口径提案.md",
      "registered_source_sha256": "b50f5683e735baa3ca6fe08bde3b437377d810732357e2a4898d6820b0456a9a"
    },
    {
      "evidence_id": "E2",
      "doc_id": "project-metric-manual",
      "doc_title": "Chinook 业务指标口径手册 项目自编",
      "page": null,
      "section_path": [
        "指标对应关系"
      ],
      "text": "指标对应关系\n指标全名 | 统计粒度 | 核心表达式\n发票销售额 | 发票 | SUM(invoice.total)\n平均每张发票金额 | 发票 | AVG(invoice.total)\n期间内复购客户数 | 期间内客户 | 发票数至少2张的客户数\n热门曲目 | 期间内曲目 | SUM(invoice_line.quantity)\n机器可读规则保存在 data/rules/metric_definitions.json。口径审核与每一道评测题的 gold 人工审核分别记录，互不替代。",
      "bbox": null,

      "text": "指标对应关系\n指标全名 | 统计粒度 | 核心表达式\n发票销售额 | 发票 | SUM(invoice.total)\n平均每张发票金额 | 发票 | AVG(invoice.total)\n期间内复购客户数 | 期间内客户 | 发票数至少2张的客户数\n热门曲目 | 期间内曲目 | SUM(invoice_line.quantity)\n机器可读规则保存在 data/rules/metric_definitions.json。口径审核与每一道评测题的 gold 人工审核分别记录，互不替代。",

        "平均每张发票金额"
      ],
      "text": "平均每张发票金额\n本项目将客单价主口径写全为平均每张发票金额，表达式 AVG(invoice.total)，每张发票权重相同。\n平均每位购买客户金额另命名为 SUM(invoice.total) / COUNT(DISTINCT invoice.customer_id)，不与每张发票平均金额混用。无发票或零分母时保留 NULL。",

      "text": "## 地区字段含义\ncustomer.country 表示客户所在地国家。invoice.billing_country 表示发票账单地址国家。两列在当前快照中相等，不能据此将两种业务含义混为同一口径。",

      "text": "### invoice\n销售发票，含客户、开票时间、账单地址及发票总额\n| 字段 | 数据类型 | 可为空 | 中文说明 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| invoice_id | integer | 否 | 发票编号 |\n| customer_id | integer | 否 | 客户编号 |\n| invoice_date | timestamp without time zone | 否 | 开票时间，不是客户创建时间 |\n| billing_address | character varying(70) | 是 | 发票账单街道地址 |\n| billing_city | character varying(40) | 是 | 发票账单城市 |\n| billing_state | character varying(40) | 是 | 发票账单州或省，可为空 |\n| billing_country | character varying(40) | 是 | 发票账单地址国家，与 customer.country 是不同字段，不可直接互换 |",
